title: Introducing Power BI Monitor: Unified Power BI Management in Business Central
summary: Power BI Monitor is a Business Central extension that centralizes Power BI management, allowing users to monitor workspaces, datasets, dataflows, reports, and dashboards without leaving BC. It enables refresh management, error tracking, and provides a dedicated role center for unified control of Power BI resources from within Business Central.
key_points: Unified view of Power BI resources including workspaces, datasets, dataflows, reports, and dashboards with real-time refresh status
Flexible refresh management with options to refresh individual resources or bulk operations, complete history logging, and performance tracking
Proactive error monitoring with a 30-day error dashboard showing statistics and detailed diagnostics for troubleshooting
Uses OAuth 2.0 authentication and service-oriented architecture to securely connect with Power BI REST APIs

quotes.text: What if you could monitor, manage, and troubleshoot all your Power BI resources without leaving BC?
quotes.why_it_matters: Captures the core value proposition of eliminating context switching between Business Central and Power BI portals

quotes.text: Power BI Monitor uses OAuth 2.0 authentication to securely connect with Power BI's REST APIs.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the technical approach and security mechanism used for integration
